label: EX2300-48T 48-port 1G access switch
description: Juniper EX2300-48T 1RU access switch: 48x 10/100/1000BASE-T RJ-45 (ge-0/0/0-47), no PoE, 4x 1G/10G SFP/SFP+ uplinks (xe-0/1/0-3), 1x RJ-45 out-of-band management port, RJ-45 serial and mini-USB Type B console, 176 Gbps packet-switching capacity, 130 Mpps, 70 W maximum input power, 2 GB DRAM, 2 GB flash, image 15.1X53-D55 or later.

fabric.note: 176 Gbps bidirectional from the EX2300 datasheet (the 48-port group) and from the per-model hardware specs, which add 88 Gbps unidirectional and 130 Mpps at 64 B. Same four-cage uplink arrangement as the 24-port models.

notes: 48 RJ-45 access ports plus 4 SFP+ uplinks, 2 console ports, 1 RJ-45 management port, 1 USB Type A. 10.2 in / 25.9 cm deep, 3.76 kg, 34.6 dB. No PoE. Base image 15.1X53-D55 whereas the 24-port models start at D50. The entry this replaces had the same missing connectors as the 24T entry.
